extracted.name: BBQ Steak
extracted.description: This BBQ steak is marinated with onion, garlic, olive oil, vinegar, soy sauce, mustard, and fresh rosemary. Great on many cuts, like tri-tip and flank.
instruction_lines: Place onion, garlic, olive oil, vinegar, soy sauce, rosemary, mustard, salt, and pepper into the bowl of a food processor. Process until marinade is smooth.
Place steak in a large resealable plastic bag. Pour marinade over steak; seal the bag and refrigerate for about 3 hours.
Preheat the grill for high heat. Brush the grate with oil.
Remove steak from marinade and place on the prepared grill grate; discard marinade. Cook on the preheated grill to desired doneness or about 7 minutes per side.
